data.narrative:
Terraform Industries is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $26M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private and 1 public peer in the Climate & Energy sector, including later-stage companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. A direct peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow frontier-tech cohort—fewer than three datapoints met filtering criteria—making sector-wide medians unreliable.

The stage-progression method was the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised of $26M as a proxy for current implied valuation, and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, this method yielded a $52M post-money valuation. This reflects the incremental value creation expected between Series A and subsequent rounds in the frontier-tech space.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $44M to $60M, with a median point estimate of $52M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological leg; widening the range reflects uncertainty around comparable company selection given the nascent and heterogeneous nature of frontier climate technologies. Key sensitivities include the applicability of standard Series A step-up multiples to early-stage climate tech and the degree of investor appetite for the subsector at the time of next fundraising.
